The structure of composition Mo₃Ru₃S₈ (reduced formula MoRuS₈) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 28 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral MoS₆ and octahedral RuS₆ environments, with Ru–S distances of 2.582 Å and Mo–S distances of 2.618 Å, while S centers coordinate to two Mo and two Ru neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include edge-sharing between Mo and Ru octahedra, as well as corner-sharing among like octahedra.
